source: MCP tools/list result; shared by every supported revision

tools.description: submit: spec/key; inspect: plan_id; list: offset/limit; cancel: plan_id/key. Runs bounded dependency plans through ordinary task admission. Unknown outcomes wait for explicit resume; no side effect is retried.

spec.description: Version 1 dependency plan; see the tools documentation.

tools.name: codex_plans

tools.description: Check installed Codex, sign-in type, pending request summaries and broker health.
tools.name: codex_status

tools.description: List selected projects with offset/limit; select/create takes path. The main agent chooses an absolute project directory.
tools.name: codex_projects

tools.description: plan/create: repo or project_id, name, optional base; create also plan_id/key. inspect: project_id or path, offset/limit. handoff: finished task_id. cleanup: project_id, optional keep_branch, key. Except inspect, needs worktrees=true. Never merges/pushes.
tools.name: codex_worktrees

tools.description: Discover model ids, supported reasoning efforts and defaults. Catalog visibility is not an entitlement guarantee.
tools.name: codex_models

tools.description: Start a persistent Codex conversation and return promptly with a task id. Poll codex_events and handle pending_requests until the turn finishes.

approval_mode.description: Native Codex reviewer; approve_for_me uses auto_review without disabling sandboxing

project_id.description: Selected project; use instead of workdir

workdir.description: Absolute project directory chosen by the main agent

tools.name: codex_start

tools.description: Page persistent tasks, newest first. Large projections identify truncated_fields.
tools.name: codex_list

tools.description: Read task state and cumulative usage. workspace_claims explain ownership; page requests, children and claims. Large fields identify truncated_fields. result pages turn evidence (pin result_id); artifact reads scoped bytes by artifact_id. Use offset/limit. reconciliation explains recovery; permissions pages receipts and scope.
tools.name: codex_get

tools.description: Replay progress or wait up to 25s. Drain has_more. For fragments, keep after and use event_seq/next_event_offset until complete. Page requests with requests_cursor. outcome coalesces state for task_ids (max 50); return cursors unchanged on the next poll. Detailed replay uses after separately.
tools.name: codex_events

tools.description: Send a follow-up turn or steer active work. Steering needs the current expected_turn_id; follow-ups can select a supported model/effort.
tools.name: codex_send

tools.description: Reconcile native history and execution intent after reconnect. No prompt or command replay. Inspect codex_history before a follow-up.
tools.name: codex_resume

tools.description: Ask Codex to interrupt the specified active turn. Poll for interrupted/completed; interrupt acknowledgement alone is not completion.
tools.name: codex_interrupt

tools.description: Page persisted turns or items for owned conversations, including after an outage. Large items identify truncated_fields; pending approval details come from codex_review_request.
tools.name: codex_history

tools.description: Page bounded pending approval/question summaries using cursor. Fetch complete content by id with codex_review_request before approval. Never infer approval from silence or timeout.
tools.name: codex_requests

tools.description: Answer guidance or review requests. Typed decisions apply only to ask_parent. Approvals need human/relay; file accepts need proposal_hash. Denials need no human.

proposal_hash.description: Required for file_approval accept: the hash displayed with the reviewed proposal

request_id.description: Pending request id, not an operation key

decision.description: Approval string or ask_parent object: version,id,context_hash,option_id,rationale. Guidance grants no authority.

tools.name: codex_respond

tools.description: Human review, or read details with offset=0. Follow next_offset and verify detail_sha256. Acceptance requires complete content.
tools.name: codex_review_request

tools.description: Discover native collaboration/permission options and direct-input capability for a task.
tools.name: codex_capabilities

tools.description: get reads settings. next takes model/effort/approval_mode/collaboration_mode/service_tier/access and root-only family budget (applies now; {} clears). current takes model/effort/approval_mode/service_tier and expected_turn_id. Changes need an operation key.

budget.description: Family lifetime limits: server turns/child admissions hard; active seconds, tokens, stored bytes soft (may overshoot). Native continuations/children may exceed admission caps. {} clears.

tools.name: codex_settings

tools.description: Page verified descendants; parent events include child requests. refresh=false uses offset; refresh=true uses cursor. Respect can_accept_direct_input.
tools.name: codex_subagents

tools.description: Ask a parent to manage native subagents; discover them with codex_subagents. Active parents require expected_turn_id.
tools.name: codex_delegate

tools.description: Fork an idle owned conversation, optionally through a selected turn. Keeps project boundaries; does not start work or automatically continue a goal.
tools.name: codex_fork

tools.description: Rename an owned native conversation.
tools.name: codex_rename

tools.description: Archive or restore an idle conversation and its native descendants. Transcripts are retained.
tools.name: codex_archive

tools.description: Permanently delete an owned native conversation and descendants. Requires the exact native thread_id in confirm_thread_id and an idle family. Local bridge audit records remain.
tools.name: codex_delete

tools.description: Request native history compaction for an idle conversation; may consume model usage. Poll completion events.
tools.name: codex_compact

tools.description: Remove a selected turn and all later native conversation history. DOES NOT revert files. Requires explicit acknowledgement; local event audit remains.
tools.name: codex_revert

tools.description: list takes cursor/limit; add takes prompt and optional images/context_files/skills; update also needs queued_id; delete needs queued_id; reorder needs ordered_ids; start takes optional queued_id. Mutations need an operation key.
tools.name: codex_queue

tools.description: Start native code review of uncommitted changes, a base branch, a commit or custom instructions on an idle task. Poll for findings/results.
tools.name: codex_review

tools.description: list takes cursor/limit; terminate takes process_id; clean stops all background terminals. Mutations need an operation key. No arbitrary shell or stdin.
tools.name: codex_terminals

tools.description: get reads a goal; set takes objective/status/token_budget; clear removes it. Mutations need user_requested=true and an operation key. Only change goals on explicit human instruction.
tools.name: codex_goal

tools.description: List native skills available for this project. Select enabled skills by name in start/send; no global skill configuration changes.
tools.name: codex_skills

tools.description: Retrieve the current native turn's diff and reported file changes; old diffs are not carried into new turns. Does not invoke Git hooks or execute a shell.
tools.name: codex_diff

tools.description: Read native account rate limits/remaining allowance. Does not buy credits or change billing.
tools.name: codex_usage

tools.description: Choose workdir or project_id. list takes cursor/limit/archived; import takes thread_id, confirm_stopped=true, optional archived and an operation key. Native scope is verified before work.

project_id.description: Selected project; use instead of workdir

workdir.description: Absolute project directory chosen by the main agent

tools.name: codex_sessions
